title: Finn & Rey Reunited
description: Poe Dameron and his fellow pilots enter Starkiller Base's atmosphere and start their attack. Finn hears the X-wing's blasts as they connect with the Starkiller. They have to find Rey soon. Han, Chewbacca, and Finn run toward the base's prison cells — and right into Rey! Together they run to find the Millennium Falcon, but when they reach the surface of the base, they see that the X-wings haven't destroyed the oscillator. The team know they have to help.
